title: Assessment and Visit Reminders
supports: Opened with WebFetch; article last updated 22 Oct 2026. Automatic or manual reminders before visits; send at a set time or relative to the visit; rescheduling cancels old reminders; text reminders only in the US, UK and Canada to mobiles with messages switched on; 160-character limit with no emoji or links; clients confirm through a Client Hub link or by replying; on select plans.

title: Automations
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last updated 28 Oct 2026. Quote follow-ups (up to two reminders, timed in days after sending, up to 90 days, same channel as the quote); invoice follow-ups after the due date; Jobber AI auto-drafting quotes from new requests for review; high-value quote alerts; follow-ups on the Connect plan and up.

title: Checklists
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last updated 30 Oct 2026. Checklists built from sections and questions (including image upload and signature); attach to assessments, jobs or single visits; required questions can still be left blank when a visit is completed; completed checklists emailed to clients as a PDF; select plans.

title: Route Optimization | New Schedule
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last updated 31 Jul 2026. Reorders anytime visits only, using driving distance; up to 7 days per run; admins on Jobber.com; first and last stops can be fixed; Connect, Grow and Plus plans.

title: Job Follow-ups
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Follow-up emails after a job closes, with an optional 0 to 10 feedback survey; email only; clients can be opted out; select plans.

title: Register your dedicated phone number
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last updated 28 Oct 2026. US carriers require businesses to register a number used for two-way texting; approval can take up to 3 weeks; web forms need consent wording; terms must say how customers opt out of texts.

title: Set up arrival windows
supports: Opened with WebFetch; published and updated 15 Oct 2026. An arrival window is the time range promised to the customer; presets by business unit; required for new and rescheduled jobs when Capacity Planning is on; lets the company track on-time arrival.

title: Day-of-dispatching: A Dispatcher's Guide in ServiceTitan Max
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 15 Oct 2026. Dispatch Pro in Auto Mode runs every 10 minutes in business hours; jobs it cannot place appear with a reason; it reschedules only within the arrival window or business hours; the dispatcher keeps the final decision.

title: Plan Your Team's Capacity
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 15 Oct 2026. Capacity planning matches technician time to booked work; Adaptive Capacity uses shifts, skills, zones and business units; booking staff see only slots an eligible technician can take.

title: Grow Recurring Revenue with Memberships
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 15 Oct 2026. Membership types set duration, price, discounts and included recurring services; billing runs in daily batches; auto-renewal; recurring service events are generated automatically and booked into jobs by staff; separate workflow for commercial service agreements.

title: Customer Notifications Overview
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Notification types: job or estimate scheduled (text and email), On My Way (text), job finished (text), review request (Reviews app); texts are not sent to landlines; notifications are switched off per customer or per job.

title: Checklists Overview
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated 15 Jul 2026. Required checklist items must be completed before a job or estimate can be marked finished; item types include pass/flag/fail and photo upload; checklists can be added automatically by job template.

title: How to Sell A Service Plan
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated 3 Sep 2026. Plans offered from an estimate, job or customer profile; customer accepts by email and pays by card, or staff accept on their behalf; visit months fill in from the start date and visit count.

title: Service Plan Renewals
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated 21 Jul 2026. Only plans with an end date can renew; renewal reminders create draft renewals that stay pending until accepted; payment is not taken automatically; reminder lead times from 1 to 60 days before expiry.

title: The Psychology of Waiting Lines
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Maister (1985): uncertain and unexplained waits feel longer than known and explained ones; anxiety lengthens waits; unfair waits feel longer; satisfaction as perception minus expectation.

title: Service Blueprints: Definition
supports: Opened with WebFetch; Sarah Gibbons, 2017, reviewed 15 Jul 2026. Service blueprint layers: customer actions, frontstage, backstage, support processes and evidence; lines of interaction and visibility; used to find root causes of poor service across teams.

title: Buyer's Remorse: The FTC's Cooling-Off Rule May Help
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated Sep 2025. Three business days to cancel covered sales at home ($25 or more) or temporary locations ($130 or more); seller must give notice and two cancellation forms; exemptions include emergencies and repairs or maintenance the buyer asked for, but extra purchases beyond the request are covered.

title: Cancelling a service you've arranged
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated (2026 copyright). Labelled a summary: legislation.gov.uk returned empty pages to WebFetch. In England, services arranged online, by phone or away from the trader's premises costing 42 pounds or more carry at least 14 days to cancel; services the customer asked to start in that period can be charged up to cancellation.

title: Returns: cancelling a purchase
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last checked by the EU 28 Apr 2026. 14-day right of withdrawal for distance and off-premises contracts; for services it runs from the contract date; urgent repair and maintenance contracts are excluded; fully delivered services are excluded if the consumer agreed to an immediate start and acknowledged losing the right.

title: If you're unhappy about poor service
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Labelled a summary of the Consumer Rights Act 2015: services must be carried out with reasonable care and skill; the trader is first offered the chance to redo the work, otherwise a discount; claims possible for up to 6 years in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, 5 in Scotland.

title: Businessperson's Guide to Federal Warranty Law
supports: Opened with WebFetch; guide dated Dec 2006, tie-in and e-warranty parts updated Mar 2018. Written warranties are optional; on products over $10 they must be titled full or limited; pre-sale availability rules over $15; tie-in conditions generally banned; the Act covers written warranties on consumer goods, not services.

title: Guarantees and returns
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last checked by the EU 5 Oct 2026. Legal guarantee of at least 2 years on goods; defects showing within 1 year presumed present at delivery (some countries 2 years); repair or replacement first, then a price cut or refund.

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers
supports: Opened with WebFetch; Nov 2024 guidance; rule effective 21 Oct 2024. Bans fake reviews, incentives conditioned on positive sentiment, undisclosed insider reviews and review suppression by threats or false accusations; asking only happy customers is not banned by the rule itself but may break the FTC Act.

title: Short guide for businesses publishing consumer reviews and complying with consumer protection law
supports: Opened with WebFetch; published 4 Apr 2025. Fake reviews, concealed incentivised reviews and false or misleading review information are banned; businesses must not write or commission fake reviews.

title: Prohibited and restricted content (Maps user contributed content policy)
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Businesses may not offer incentives for reviews, discourage negative reviews or selectively ask for positive ones; staff review quotas are not allowed; genuine reviews may be encouraged.

title: Read and reply to reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Verified businesses can reply; replies are checked against content policies (usually within 10 minutes, up to 30 days); replies are public and the reviewer is notified and can change the review.

title: Write It Right: A Guide for Automotive Repair Dealers
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated Jan 2026. California only: a written estimate and the customer's authorisation before work; revised work order and documented approval (date, time, name, number) before extra work; itemised invoice; replaced parts returned on request.

title: Housecall Pro pricing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Plans named Basic, Essentials and Max; 14-day free trial, no free plan; Max includes open API access and Zapier; CSR AI is an add-on; every plan lists AI team members. Prices deliberately not recorded.
